title: ORDER #000 - Part 1
notes: Qwen3-TTS. narrator = VIDEO_008 design; streamer = VIDEO_009 'her' design (fx phone); Sam is new, heard through the front door (fx door).

narrator.ref_text: It was late, and the street outside was quiet. Somewhere a door closed, and I waited.

streamer.ref_text: Okay, your handwriting is honestly the worst I've ever seen. No, I'm kidding. Kind of. Hand me the glue?

sam.design: Man in his 30s, delivery driver, unnaturally polite and cheerful, slow flat monotone, every word evenly spaced, like someone imitating a friendly person.
sam.ref_text: Hello. I have a delivery for you. Thank you for your order. Please enjoy your meal. Have a wonderful night.

lines.text: It's two AM. You order food. The app says your driver is one minute away... but the restaurant is forty minutes from your house.
It starts like every night. You're in bed, scrolling TikTok, watching mukbangs.
Now you're starving. One tap. Order placed.
Before you even put your phone down... three knocks.
You check the door camera. A delivery guy. He isn't blinking. And his smile is way too wide.
"Delivery for you. Please open the door. Your food is getting cold."
Your phone buzzes. The app says your real driver is still at the restaurant.
When the camera comes back, he's gone. You run to your room and lock the door.
The bag is already on your bed.
On your phone, the mukbang is still playing. But the girl has stopped eating. She's staring right at you.
"Don't open the bag. That's how he gets in."
Then... the bag starts to move.
Comment A or B. The top comment decides what happens in Part 2.
